spec: V2 R6 part 2 (COMBAT-V2-DESIGN-2026-09-07 section 11.2, ruled 2026-09-07). The loadout swap: a hero may exchange what is in its hands for stowed weapons and shields, once per activation, only before its primary action (before or after its move), paying swapCost stamina. swapCost is a foldable stat, default 1. A Surge reopens the swap. Enemies never swap. The swap re-folds the hands: the outgoing items' attacks, powers and stat modifiers leave, the incoming items' arrive; the hand limit holds. It emits loadout.swapped (unit, hands before, hands after, stamina spent) and one unit.equipped per incoming instance.
expect: Swapping longsword for a stowed kite shield before the primary costs 1 stamina, removes the longsword's attacks, adds the shield's Block and powers, and emits loadout.swapped; a second swap in the same activation, a swap after the primary, a swap without the stamina and an enemy swap are refused by the one legality function; after a Surge a second swap is legal; swapCost folded to 0 or 2 charges that; Health lost from a Health modifier clamps current Health to the new maximum.
note: Andrew's chat, 2026-09-24 (V2 roadmap R6, second of two). Replaces v2.swap, which was filed with changesBaseline and no variants: the control battles do not move (the AI does not swap, SWITCHES.md swapAi; no control unit carries swapCost), and the mechanism's data instances are the swapCost badges. v2.swap is superseded — abandon it from a terminal. TEST content: test.badge.fast-hands (swapCost -1), test.badge.slow-hands (+1), scenario test.swap. Defaults in SWITCHES.md 'V2 swap'.
